10.4.1: Josiah king at eight, began reform at twelve, temple repairs (curators include "Eliakim the high priest"); 10.4.2: in the eighteenth year the high priest found "the holy books of Moses"; Huldah: God would delay the calamities because Josiah was righteous; 10.4.3: covenant with an oath; 10.4.4: bones burned on Jeroboam's altar as the prophet [Jadon] foretold, fulfilled "after three hundred and sixty-one years"; 10.4.5: Passover, none like it "from the times of Samuel"; 10.5.1: Neco marched to the Euphrates "to fight with the Medes and Babylonians"; Josiah blocked him, was shot by an Egyptian archer, retreated to Jerusalem "and died of that wound"; lived 39 years, reigned 31; Jeremiah's elegy; 10.5.2: Jehoahaz deposed at Hamath after three months and ten days
